title: BASSO Venta Disc Shimano 105 Microtech MCT
notes: Exact old-generation Venta Disc 105 retailer specification supports a 100% UD Torayca TR50/MR60 carbon frame, TR50 fork, Shimano 105 2x11 reference build, 28 mm fitted tires, and 9.05 kg for size M without pedals. Other exact builds and reviews report different weights, so none is transferred to the trim-ambiguous mainland price lead.
